mapper.select: SELECT a.approval_id AS approvalId, ar.title AS title FROM file_version fv JOIN approval_document ad ON ad.file_version_id = fv.file_version_id AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN approval_revision ar ON ar.approval_revision_id = ad.approval_revision_id JOIN approval a ON a.approval_id = ar.approval_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE fv.file_id = #{fileId} AND a.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' LIMIT 1
